source: Parcel-level land-conveyance records retrieved from China Land Market (中国土地市场网), 2012–2024; source file is not included in this release.
access_status: Publicly accessible data; processed city-year summaries are included in this release, while the original parcel-level source file is not redistributed.
unit: CNY 10,000 per hectare, numerically equal to CNY per square metre
price_basis: Nominal transaction prices; not deflated or quality-adjusted
main_statistic: Arithmetic mean of parcel unit prices within each city-year, then equal-weight mean across the same 11 cities each year
inference: Descriptive time trend, not an identified effect of either policy

cooperation_evidence.Li_2025: Section 5.3 and Figure 4: post-pairing increases in intercounty investment persist beyond initial designation; this is not a survival estimate for individual enclave ties.
cooperation_evidence.Zhang_2023: Case description p.1734: park jointly established August 2013; p.1737 reports 2020 industrial output. Continued park activity does not measure the survival of all provincial partnerships.
